editorial.description_en: The darkest of the seasonal entries: a night cold enough to frost, with barely any colour left in it.
editorial.description_ja: 霜のおりる夜のような、いちばん暗い青灰色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.240, C 0.034, h 258.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 霜 (shimo, frost) + 夜 (yo, night). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Frost Night" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 霜夜. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — yoru-gami at ΔE00 5.3, shizumi-ao at ΔE00 7.7, soko-zumi at ΔE00 8.8. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.034 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
